correctness.rationale: Exhaustive dual simplex enumeration gives 6125 faces; complete 25176-edge Hasse DAG verifies 2724 pairs and one 0-cell plus 675 four-cells. The signed simplicial Lefschetz trace formula determines all 48 character values because homology is concentrated in degree four. The explicit induced Specht formulas give ten irreducible characters and ten exact integer inner products; dimensions total 675. Average character gives eleven invariant classes, and rational transfer gives the quotient cohomology ring. Standalone source and exact recorded output supplied.

value.rationale: This is the full representation invariant for a canonical graph with full octahedral symmetry, not a repetition of the already known 675-sphere homotopy type. Ten irreducible multiplicities, the central 325/350 splitting, and eleven independent invariant quotient classes are meaningful structurally motivated information absent from, and not implied by, the established shelling or sphere count. The result is finite and single-object scoped; no family theorem is claimed.
